a2a2a_message.action_requested: A2A Queue Health Monitor Script — Auto-Detect Stale/Orphaned Task Packets

context.goal:
The A2A queue has a systemic problem: tasks are being moved to done/ WITHOUT being executed (task_001 through task_011 all landed in done/ but their work was never done — verified: services/ai-backend/ doesn't exist, dev-dashboard still has 3 files, orchestrator still has 7083 files).

Create a Python monitoring script at scripts/a2a_queue_health.py that:
1. Scans _A2A_QUEUE/inbox/, _A2A_QUEUE/assigned/{claude,codex,opencode}/, _A2A_QUEUE/done/, _A2A_QUEUE/blocked/
2. For each packet, validates: JSON schema correctness, status field, TTL expiry (ttl_seconds + timestamp vs now)
3. Flags packets in done/ whose deliverables were NOT actually produced (cross-reference with filesystem)
4. Reports: inbox count, assigned count by agent, done count, stale packets (TTL expired), orphaned packets (no deliverable evidence)
5. Outputs a health report JSON to scripts/a2a_health_report.json
6. Optional CLI flag: --auto-rewire (moves stale done/ packets back to inbox/ if deliverables missing)

queue_structure: done/ (11 task packets + other archives — ALL suspected unexecuted)
verified_state.known_problem: Tasks moved to done without execution. This is the ROOT CAUSE of the refactor plan stalls.

constraints: Read-only by default (no file moves without --auto-rewire flag)
Do NOT modify existing packets, only read + report
--auto-rewire must confirm each move with dry-run output first
deliverables: Run it once and produce scripts/a2a_health_report.json as baseline
Validates a2a2a_message schema, TTL, and deliverable evidence
context.refactor_plan_ref: Cross-cutting: addresses systemic task execution failure

tier_rationale: Tier A: Read-only monitoring script. Creates one new file in scripts/. No existing file modification, no deploy, no push. The --auto-rewire is opt-in and dry-run first.
